## MGIT Inaugurates Magistech-2026, a National-Level Technical Symposium Uniting the Tech Fests of All 11 Departments

News Date : 16 Oct 2026News ReportIndustry leaders inspire students at the opening of the two-day symposium organised by the ISTE Students’ Chapter and the Institution’s Innovation CouncilGandipet, Hyderabad | October 16, 2026Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, inaugurated Magistech-2026, a two-day national-level technical symposium, on October 16, 2026. The symposium, held on October 16–17, 2026, is jointly organised by the ISTE Students’ Chapter and the Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC) of MGIT.Magistech-2026 brings the technical fests of all 11 departments of the institute together under one umbrella. It gives students a platform to showcase their technical skills, creativity, innovation and problem-solving abilities through a wide range of events, including paper presentations, Project Expo, Robotics, Drone Challenges, Tech Quiz, AI-based activities and coding competitions.The inaugural ceremony was graced by Chief Guest Mr. Kotla Ugender Kumar, Founder & CEO, GROUPIN, along with Ms. Triveni Bonthu, Director, Enterprise Apps, LTM; Mr. Abhishek Ganguly, Senior Director, TiE Hyderabad; and Mr. Anirudh Reddy Vancha, Vice President, Piazza Consulting Group. The guests shared insights from their industry and entrepreneurial journeys and encouraged students to make the most of platforms that build practical skills and an innovative mindset.Principal Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy addressed the gathering and encouraged students to embrace interdisciplinary learning, innovation and collaboration, and to work on projects that create meaningful social impact.With insights from industry leaders and enthusiastic participation from students across disciplines, Magistech-2026 celebrates the spirit of technology, creativity and innovation at MGIT.

Gandipet, Hyderabad | October 16, 2026
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, inaugurated Magistech-2026, a two-day national-level technical symposium, on October 16, 2026. The symposium, held on October 16–17, 2026, is jointly organised by the ISTE Students’ Chapter and the Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC) of MGIT.
Magistech-2026 brings the technical fests of all 11 departments of the institute together under one umbrella. It gives students a platform to showcase their technical skills, creativity, innovation and problem-solving abilities through a wide range of events, including paper presentations, Project Expo, Robotics, Drone Challenges, Tech Quiz, AI-based activities and coding competitions.
The inaugural ceremony was graced by Chief Guest Mr. Kotla Ugender Kumar, Founder & CEO, GROUPIN, along with Ms. Triveni Bonthu, Director, Enterprise Apps, LTM; Mr. Abhishek Ganguly, Senior Director, TiE Hyderabad; and Mr. Anirudh Reddy Vancha, Vice President, Piazza Consulting Group. The guests shared insights from their industry and entrepreneurial journeys and encouraged students to make the most of platforms that build practical skills and an innovative mindset.
Principal Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy addressed the gathering and encouraged students to embrace interdisciplinary learning, innovation and collaboration, and to work on projects that create meaningful social impact.
With insights from industry leaders and enthusiastic participation from students across disciplines, Magistech-2026 celebrates the spirit of technology, creativity and innovation at MGIT.
